## Publication Information

**Date:** 1863

**Imprint:** <i>MP</i> (April 1863) 412-8

**Notes:** This account of the procession of the wedding of the Prince of Wales and Princess Alexandra is ascribed to Ann Carter Smith on the authority of CMY's letter of acknowledgment.
